div.div:
Orange: external participant. Navy: transformation. Green open-ended symbol: retained data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. Account validation
includes registration/profile updates, native Google sign-in and verification-mail delivery. Session rotation/recovery and authorization guards are shown in sequences 17–22.
